## Purpose

Describe the change and link any related issues (`Closes #...` only if this PR actually resolves them).

## Evidence / reproducibility

- [ ] `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v` passes
- [ ] `python3 -m thorbench references` remains valid (if model references changed)
- [ ] Results are labeled as local observations versus third-party published claims
- [ ] No hostnames, private IPs, credentials, device serials, prompts, weight files or personal paths
- [ ] Docs, changelog and version updated if behavior changes

## Release impact

Is the change breaking, additive or a documentation-only fix? Note any planned release tag.
